description: Set inks for separations as the Ink Manager does: alias a spot ink to another ink, set ink type, neutral density and trapping sequence, convert spot inks (or all of them) to process, use standard Lab values for spots, and choose which ink plates print with their screen frequency and angle (Ink Manager; Print > Output > Inks)

allSpotsToProcess.description: Convert every spot ink to process (true) or back to spot (false) (All Spots to Process)

inks.description: Settings per ink; only the options you pass change

alias.description: Print this ink on another ink's plate: that ink's name (Ink Alias)

angle.description: Screen angle of the ink, degrees (Output > Inks > Angle) (0 to 360)

convertToProcess.description: Print a spot ink as process (the ink's process icon)

frequency.description: Screen frequency of the ink, lpi (Output > Inks > Frequency) (1 to 500)

name.description: Ink name, e.g. "Process Cyan" or a spot colour (get_inks lists them)

print.description: Print this ink's plate when printing separations (Output > Inks, print icon)

trapOrder.description: Position in the trapping sequence (Trapping Sequence) (1 to 100)

useStandardLabValuesForSpots.description: Use Lab values for spot colours (Use Standard Lab Values for Spots)

name: set_separation_inks
title: Set Separation Inks
